name: Riblah
line: Riblah was an ancient city in the land of Hamath, where foreign kings made their base and where Judah's last kings and leaders met hard punishment.

moments.title: Jehoahaz Imprisoned
moments.text: Pharaoh Neco locked up Jehoahaz at Riblah so he could not rule in Jerusalem. Neco also made Judah pay a heavy fine of silver and gold.

moments.title: Zedekiah Judged
moments.text: Soldiers from Babylon caught King Zedekiah and brought him to the king of Babylon at Riblah, where the king decided his punishment. Zedekiah's sons were killed before his eyes, and then he was blinded and taken to Babylon in bronze chains.

moments.title: Leaders Put to Death
moments.text: Nebuzaradan brought the priests, officials, and other men taken from Jerusalem to the king of Babylon at Riblah. There the king put them to death, and the people of Judah were taken away from their own land.
